subject: Spatial modelling course slides and practicals available

messages.subject: Spatial modelling course slides and practicals available
parts:
Hi listfolk,

As most of you already know, back in October, Jason Roberts (Marine
Geospatial Ecology Lab, Duke University) and I put on a course on
spatial modelling of distance sampling data.

I wanted to let you know that the workshop materials are available
online for you to consult, should you be interested.

You can access the course website at:

http://distancesampling.org/workshops/duke-spatial-2015/

This includes a series of "practicals" that have a worked example of
analysing sperm whale data from NOAA surveys on the east coast of the
USA. Hopefully, these will complement the Gulf of Mexico pantropical
spotted dolphin analysis vignette already available on the Distance
website and provide a useful example for those starting out on a density
surface model analysis.


We hope these are useful!

best,
--dave
